faqs.q: Is CV Builder Pro really free?
faqs.a: Yes. Every template and the PDF download are free, with no account and no watermark on your CV.

faqs.q: Will my CV pass an ATS screen?
faqs.a: Our templates use a single-column, text-based layout with standard section headings, which applicant tracking systems parse reliably. Keep your job title and skills in the words the advert uses.
In your browser only. Your CV is saved to this device’s local storage and is never uploaded to a server.
